historical_transitions.summary: At block 18194082 the EIP-1967 implementation slot of the ankrETH TransparentUpgradeableProxy rotates from 0x3ed1dfbccf893b7d2d730ead3e5edbf1f8f95a48 (verified AETH_R18) to 0xe672e0e0101a7f58d728751e2a5e6da5ff1fda64 (verified AETH_R21). eth_getStorageAt at 18194081 returns the old value and at 18194082 the new one. Transaction 0xbfd3fc6743b2b90d1914e153b6ce1e10710c0c2569bfe517057a9ad060686129 was sent to the 3-of-5 Safe 0xA3464e1b86EE6941A600f9F69C61A47322af918F, succeeded with status 0x1 and emitted the Upgraded log. The admin slot stays 0xCc4E08A5BFA887621Ad68826a0D5913d7a2cb392.

Safe signer rotation at block 23377105 (2025-09-16). Receipt status 0x1 emits RemovedOwner for 0xb64f7b84af9919a5d8cbb063283942aa834df8fd and AddedOwner for 0x922a8affe0a3f6bb8940281c05fc65f4993d64dc on Safe 0xA3464e1b86EE6941A600f9F69C61A47322af918F, plus ExecutionSuccess. Paired archive getOwners() reads at 23377104 and 23377105 confirm the second array element changed while ownerCount and threshold stayed at five and three. Reproducible with cast call 0xA3464e1b86EE6941A600f9F69C61A47322af918F "getOwners()(address[])" --block 23377105 --rpc-url https://eth.drpc.org. The proxy admin slot is unchanged.

Second Safe signer rotation at block 25887947 (2026-09-02). Receipt status 0x1 emits RemovedOwner for 0x0d68cda4a0640205ed29e9efca5646d9474ae430 and AddedOwner for 0x39575f3413c727970e4ed642c27e801fa807dfff on the same Safe, plus ExecutionSuccess. An archive getOwners() read at 25887946 still returns the old fourth owner and at 25887947 the new one. The implementation slot remains 0xe672e0e0101a7f58d728751e2a5e6da5ff1fda64; this is a governance change, not an implementation upgrade.

Terminal transition at block 26429786 (2026-11-16). Receipt status 0x1 rotates the implementation from 0xe672e0e0101a7f58d728751e2a5e6da5ff1fda64 to the unverified 0x5403cf3da1920e46b6ec07724407ab6f5c041402 and, in the same transaction, emits OperatorChanged from 0xcc96eec323be48530802feb8d48b7838eccd123b to 0xf1a46729ff58b014000f62d9d154da400ab27d71, a second Upgraded log on companion proxy 0xd01ef7c0a5d8c432fc2d1a85c66cf2327362e5c6, and ExecutionSuccess on the Safe. The EIP-1967 admin slot remains 0xCc4E08A5BFA887621Ad68826a0D5913d7a2cb392, but the signer set had already rotated twice, so no invariant signer claim is made.

This sampled README does not publish the ProxyAdmin, the Safe, the implementation rotations or the two signer swaps; it is a documentation repo, not a contract source tree.

gap_windows.summary: Documentation-to-chain disclosure gap bounded to the three sampled documentation pages. Those sampled README/index pages do not publish the ProxyAdmin 0xCc4E08A5BFA887621Ad68826a0D5913d7a2cb392, the Safe 0xA3464e1b86EE6941A600f9F69C61A47322af918F, the two implementation rotations or the two signer swaps, while the on-chain control plane is fully reproducible from the four receipts and archive storage reads. This is NOT a claim of continuous absence across every documentation page. The window opens at the first verified transition, block 18194082, and remains open with no closed block because no repair commit was identified in the sampled repository history.

executive_risk_memo:
This dossier replaces an earlier submission that treated the plain fixed-supply ANKR ERC-20 token 0x8290333ceF9e6D528dD5618Fb97a76f268f3EDD4 as the Ankr liquid-staking control plane. Direct eth_call name() and symbol() return 'Ankr Network' / 'ANKR' for that address and 'Ankr Staked ETH' / 'ankrETH' for 0xE95A203B1a91a908F9B9CE46459d101078c2c3cb, so pacta_slug is null and the EIP-1967 proxy is assessed as an unindexed protocol with 14,563,474 USD of Ethereum TVL per DefiLlama. The runtime is a 2261-byte TransparentUpgradeableProxy whose implementation slot rotates twice and whose controller is the ProxyAdmin 0xCc4E08A5BFA887621Ad68826a0D5913d7a2cb392, owned by the 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe 0xA3464e1b86EE6941A600f9F69C61A47322af918F with no guard, no timelock and empty modules.

Control-plane trajectory, all four transitions replayable on public archive RPC. At block 18,194,082 (2023-09-22) transaction 0xbfd3fc6743b2b90d1914e153b6ce1e10710c0c2569bfe517057a9ad060686129 upgraded the implementation from 0x3ed1dfbc...5a48 to 0xe672e0e0...da64. At block 23,377,105 (2025-09-16) transaction 0x8fe9e9efa1aed2b599afc30c42c9e9b1856093119cf2050824d8e69d0ae627b9 emitted RemovedOwner(0xb64f7b84af9919a5d8cbb063283942aa834df8fd) and AddedOwner(0x922a8affe0a3f6bb8940281c05fc65f4993d64dc) on the Safe. At block 25,887,947 (2026-09-02) transaction 0xf8c278539f965eff493240fd183fd9073bd3bd98ac86cd39941479c8ea82dbc9 emitted RemovedOwner(0x0d68cda4a0640205ed29e9efca5646d9474ae430) and AddedOwner(0x39575f3413c727970e4ed642c27e801fa807dfff) on the same Safe. At block 26,429,786 (2026-11-16) transaction 0x65248026dc0153f86ca29c4f4d2af64485d7ef1b332b9007d07580af79886d76 upgraded the implementation to 0x5403cf3d...1402 and, in the same receipt, emitted OperatorChanged(0xcc96eec323be48530802feb8d48b7838eccd123b -> 0xf1a46729ff58b014000f62d9d154da400ab27d71) plus a second Upgraded log on the companion proxy 0xd01ef7c0...2e5c6. Paired archive getOwners() calls on the Safe at blocks 18,194,082, 23,377,104, 23,377,105, 25,887,946, 25,887,947 and 26,429,786 confirm the two signer replacements while the ProxyAdmin admin slot and the 3-of-5 threshold stayed constant. The earlier claim of an invariant signer set was wrong and is withdrawn.

Source provenance is now distinguished accurately. Blockscout reports the two historical implementations as verified Solidity: 0x3ed1dfbc...5a48 is 'AETH_R18' and 0xe672e0e0...da64 is 'AETH_R21', both compiled with solc 0.6.11+commit.5ef660b1. The current implementation 0x5403cf3d...1402 installed at block 26,429,786 is unverified on Blockscout and Sourcify. Reviewers can therefore read and compile the historical logic but cannot audit the currently executing implementation from published source. This corrects the earlier blanket statement that no Solidity source exists.

Engineering bench: Ankr-network/ankr-docs is a documentation repository (MDX only, 60 commits from 4 accounts in the trailing twelve months, zero Solidity commits). It cannot establish a core smart-contract bus_factor; the value 1 in repo_audit is only the schema's lower bound for that documentation repository, not a claim about the engineers who maintain the staking contracts. code_before_upgrade_verified remains false because no dated public commit in that repository predates and matches either on-chain implementation rotation, even though explorer verification exists for the two historical implementations.

The documentation-to-chain gap is deliberately bounded to the three sampled pages (the 2022 Wayback capture, the dated 2026 GitHub README commit and the live docs index). Those sampled pages do not publish the ProxyAdmin, the Safe, the implementation rotations or the signer swaps; this dossier does NOT claim continuous absence across every documentation page. The gap window opens at the first verified transition, block 18,194,082, not at an unproven block 18,000,000, and remains unrepaired_open for 1155 days.

Residual exposure is governance latency: a 3-of-5 Safe with no guard and no timelock can rotate implementations at any block, and two of its five signers were in fact replaced during the window. The unverified current implementation concentrates additional risk because neither reviewers nor integrators can compare it against a canonical source tree before the next upgrade.
